title: Customer Ask Curation & Scoping Bridge for Sales/CS Inbound
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Purpose: create a repeatable lightweight workflow that turns inbound Sales/CS enterprise asks (non-bug feature requests) into a single canonical card with an initial scoping signal. This reduces duplicate asks, speeds engineering triage, and produces a prioritized backlog item with clear next actions for product, eng, and design.

Scope: covers new feature requests, integration asks (SAML, KMS, VPC), capacity/throughput requests tied to Dedicated/Private, and large UX changes requested by accounts. Does not cover bugs, billing disputes, or incidents (those continue to follow existing paths).
acceptance_criteria: A consolidated intake template (GSheet) exists and is linked on the CS/Sales intake page
Each inbound enterprise ask results in a canonical Linear card within 48 hours
Initial scoping fields completed (user story, success metrics, rough effort, SLA/ROI flag, required security/compliance)
RICE-like preliminary score computed and stored on the card
Escalation rules implemented for >$250k ARR accounts and legal/security requests
intake_steps: 1. CS/Sales submit ask via intake form (sends to shared mailbox + webhook to GSheet)
2. Intake coordinator (CS ops) de-duplicates against active canonical asks
3. PM assigned to triage within 48h: fill summary, customer context, desired outcome, and attach transcript/PRD link
4. PM completes quick-scan: business impact band (low/med/high), deployment type (hosted/dedicated/private), security constraints, and rough effort band (S/M/L)
5. If high-impact or >$250k ARR then auto-notify Eng/Design leads for rapid sync
6. If request likely >3 sprints, flag for roadmap review and schedule discovery spike
scoping_heuristics: Effort bands: S (1-3 pts) for UI toggle or minor API; M (5-8 pts) for new route or storage change; L (13+ pts) for new runtime/architecture work
Deployment impact: Private/VPC asks add +1 effort band for ops/security integration
Quantifiable success metric required: e.g., reduced latency to X ms, support load decreased by Y%, new ARR/capacity enabled
Regulatory/Compliance escalator: any request that mentions audit logs, encryption-at-rest keys, or data residency -> trigger Security review
Duplication rule: if two or more accounts request similar capability, aggregate and add customers to canonical ask
scoring_sample: E (Effort): relative story points converted to denominator
Calculation: R*I*C / E -> used for initial sort and to recommend whether to schedule discovery
deliverables: Canonical intake Linear card with tags: customer-list, deployment-type, security-reqs
Linked intake sheet row containing raw submission + transcript/PRD links
Initial RICE-like score and recommended next step: (do/discovery/reject/hold)
Quarterly rollup doc for PM/GTMs summarizing aggregated asks and estimated ROI
communication_playbook: Automated acknowledgement to submitter within 1 business day with expected timeline
Weekly digest to Sales leadership for newly created high-impact asks
Template response for requests needing legal/security review to gather required artifacts
Post-triage notification to account owner summarizing decision and next steps
privacy_and_compliance_notes: When request includes customer data samples, require redaction or secure upload to approved bucket
For KMS/HSM requests, capture key lifecycle expectations and support model (customer-managed vs vendor-managed)
Data residency asks must include target region(s) and compliance rationale

examples_and_edge_cases: Edge: Account asks for peak TPS of 10k with private deployment. Action: flag as L effort + infra discovery spike; notify infra-eng lead.
Edge: Multiple small customers request same minor UI label change. Action: aggregate under single canonical ask and treat as low-effort bundle.
